ruleName: Relief for Ball in Penalty Area
title: Lateral Relief from a Red Penalty Area
question: After your ball comes to rest in a red penalty area, how far from the point where the ball last crossed the edge of the penalty area may you drop under the lateral relief option?

choices.text: As far back as you wish.

explanation: When taking lateral relief from a red penalty area under Rule 17.1d(3), you must drop the ball within two club-lengths of the point where the ball last crossed the edge of the penalty area, not nearer the hole.

The golfer is holding another ball out over the grass, about to let go and drop it outside the penalty area. The scene is well-lit and visually clear.
